ns2:course.label: Senior Honors
ns2:course.description: Independent creative activity, guided study, or research for honors. No graduate credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 5 hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing in Art & Design, a cumulative grade point average of 3.0; and consent of instructor, advisor, and associate director of the School.
